🌟 dnsglobe | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring and visualizing DNS record propagation across a wide range of global DNS resolvers directly from the terminal.
✨ Key Features: • Global DNS propagation checking across 34 resolvers • Terminal User Interface (TUI) with world map visualization • Real-time monitoring with watch mode • Direct querying of resolvers with EDNS0 and TCP fallback • Grouping of identical answers for round-robin DNS
📖 Summary: dnsglobe is a terminal-based TUI application written in Rust that checks DNS record propagation across 34 global public DNS resolvers. It visualizes the results on a world map within the terminal, allowing users to monitor DNS changes in real-time.
